subheader: Charged the month the work is done, never again afterwards.
lead: None of these is compulsory. A practice that migrates its own data and trains itself pays the monthly price and nothing else.
note: All figures are net and are invoiced in the month the work is completed. Work outside 07:00–19:00 on a working day is charged at 150 %. Travel outside Vienna is €0.50 per kilometre.

fees.title: Data migration
fees.text: Patients, appointments, open invoices and scanned documents from your current system, reconciled against your own record counts before go-live.

fees.title: On-site setup day
fees.text: One working day at the practice: workstations, printers, card terminal and the first live morning with somebody in the room.

fees.title: Remote training, half day
fees.text: Four hours for the whole team, recorded and left with you.

fees.title: Card-terminal configuration
fees.text: Per terminal, connected and tested with a real payment.

fees.title: Extra address set-up
fees.text: Rooms, opening hours and practitioners for one further treatment address.

fees.title: Template design
fees.text: Your letterhead, findings template and invoice layout rebuilt in Talbrunn. Per set of three documents.

fees.title: Export and handover on leaving
fees.text: Free, whenever you ask for it and whatever the reason. Charging for the exit would make the data hostage rather than yours.
